_comment: Pipeline settings. Days-back windows control incremental pulls; the first run does a backfill of backfill_days.

marginedge._provisional_comment: While true, every MarginEdge-sourced panel in the portal carries a 'provisional' badge. Set to false once onboarding is finished and the data-entry practices have settled.

category_map._comment: Maps Toast sales-category names and MarginEdge category types onto the five portal buckets used for COGS% and sales mix.

site.title: Big Grove Brewery — Store Director Portal

inventory._comment: How often each category is EXPECTED to be counted, in days. Drives the count-compliance score; it does not change any dollar figure.

channels._comment: Marketplace commission as a fraction of net sales (0.25 = 25%). null = not entered: the portal then shows channel sales and says the margin is unknown rather than assuming a rate.

pours._comment: Overrides for sdp/pours.py. keywords maps a word found in a beer's modifier or name to fluid ounces. Every value is an assumption about how the taprooms ring draft; correct them from the 'could not be sized' list on the Beer volume panel. default_draft_oz stays null until that list has been read.

items._comment: Exact item name -> ounces, for beers rung with no size anywhere. Examples: "Half Time Tiger Hawk": 16   or   "Mich Ultra": {"oz": 12, "pour": "package"}. Work down the 'could not be sized' list on the Beer page.
